description:
The account's metering: the free documents used of the allowance, the credits left, and this month's spend against the organisation's spend cap.

Needs the key's 'read' scope, which keys have by default. Free: it reads, and changes nothing.

Returns: { credits, free_docs_used, free_docs_limit, spent_this_month, spend_cap (null for none), at_cap, near_cap (80% of the cap or more), plan?, spend_cap_overage?, overage_credits?, link }. At the cap, submits are refused unless the plan allows overage.
name: handinloop_get_usage
title: Get Usage and Spend
